scenes.headline: How a diffusion language model writes a block at once
scenes.sub: Mercury 3, and what its speed claim rests on
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Harrow! Here is how Mercury 3, a diffusion language model, writes a block of text at once.

scenes.text: Instead of one token per pass, it drafts a whole block and refines it over a few parallel passes.
scenes.mark: refines it over a few parallel passes
scenes.say: Instead of one token per pass, it drafts a whole block, then refines it over a few passes.

scenes.title: Why one token per pass is slow

left.title: One token per pass
items: Each token waits for the last
Every pass reads all the weights
The GPU mostly waits on memory
left.say: The usual model writes one token per pass, and each pass streams every weight from memory.

right.title: A block per pass
items: Every masked slot predicted at once
right.say: A diffusion model predicts every masked slot at once, so the same reads produce more text.

scenes.title: Block diffusion, one pass at a time

steps.say: The current block starts as all masks. The denoiser reads it, plus the prompt and finished blocks, which never change and can be cached.
In one pass it guesses every masked slot, and keeps only the most confident guesses.
The rest go back to masks for another pass, with more neighbours now fixed.
When the block is full, it streams out, becomes context, and the next block begins.

items.say: Fixing more tokens per pass means fewer passes.

items.text: Each slot from its own guess
items.say: But each slot is sampled on its own, so hot dog and ice cream can become hot cream.
And fewer passes only become speed with an engine built for it, which Inception keeps private.

scenes.title: Five generations, by size and quality

steps.say: Inception's chart starts at Mercury One Mini, whose size it has never published.
Mercury 3 sits about forty times larger, at about three times the quality average.

scenes.title: Routed traffic, median throughput
scenes.say: On OpenRouter, Mercury 3 is the fastest of the three. But the launch chart's one thousand sixty-eight becomes three hundred and two.

scenes.text: The parallel draft is real speed; the launch number is Inception's own, and routed traffic keeps less of it.
scenes.mark: the launch number is Inception's own
scenes.say: The parallel draft is real speed. The launch number is Inception's own, and routed traffic keeps less.

recap: Draft a block, refine in parallel
Cache finished blocks like a prefix
Check speed claims in routed traffic
scenes.say: Draft a block, refine it in parallel, cache what is finished, and check speed claims where real traffic runs.
